notes: MotionSense dataset. Collected with an Apple iPhone 6s kept in the participant's front trouser pocket using the Core Motion framework. Sensors: accelerometer (userAcceleration) and gyroscope (rotationRate); also attitude and gravity are provided. Sampling rate 50 Hz. 24 participants (differing gender, age, weight, height). 6 activities: downstairs, upstairs, walking, jogging, sitting, standing, recorded over 15 trials per subject (short and long trials) in the same environment/conditions. The paper's main contribution is a privacy/anonymization autoencoder (Guardian-Estimator-Neutralizer); the dataset is the standard HAR benchmark released with it. Repo also references an earlier workshop paper (W-P2DS'18 / MobiSys workshop) 'Protecting Sensory Data against Sensitive Inferences'.
